title: German intraday price index ID AEP (TSOs' Index Ausgleichsenergiepreis), quarter-hourly, DE-LU.
source: netztransparenz.de (German TSOs), public CSV download of the Index Ausgleichsenergiepreis page
source_url_template: https://www.netztransparenz.de/DesktopModules/LotesCharts/CsvDownloadHandler.ashx?request=<base64 of JSON {LocalFrom: YYYY-MM-01, LocalTo: first day of next month (exclusive), ResultTimeZone: utc, Settings: page chart settings}>
licence: proprietary (copyright German TSOs; reproduction needs prior written consent)
attribution: 50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT TSO, TransnetBW via netztransparenz.de (Index Ausgleichsenergiepreis)
transformation_notes: timestamp_utc = start of the quarter-hour delivery product (UTC); the CSV is requested with ResultTimeZone=utc so DST days carry 92 / 100 rows without ambiguity. resolution_minutes = 15.

id_aep_eur_mwh = ID AEP in EUR/MWh: volume-weighted average price of the most recent continuous intraday exchange trades (German market area) of the quarter-hour product covering 500 MW, topped up with the hourly product when the quarter-hour product traded less; NaN where the index is not defined (< 500 MW in both).

Monthly requests (local delivery days, LocalTo exclusive) are concatenated, de-duplicated on timestamp_utc, reindexed to a complete 15-minute UTC grid (missing quarter-hours are NaN) and cut after the last complete local delivery day. Values are float32.
note: Not redistributed: the netztransparenz.de imprint requires the German TSOs' prior written consent for any reproduction of the site content. rows/sha256 describe the locally built file at retrieval time; rebuild it with the fetch command (no account needed).
